messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGER: service=inference-canary sev=high - symptom: elevated p99 + internal 5xx spike during canary rollout. paging @oncall_rita and @ml_sre_mateo

oncall_rita: On call, jumping in. Any live customer impact? Opening a bridge.

support_maya: Two active tickets from dedicated customers (IDs 7788, 7789). They reported timeouts ~28-32s. I flagged as P1.

ml_sre_mateo: Looking at metrics: p50 unchanged, p95 ~2x, p99 ~3x. Error rate up ~1.2% from baseline 0.04%. Pattern is requests with token_count > 1500.

prod_eng_lee: Canary rollout started ~T-4m. New model: rwdx-v3.4 quant=8bit flag=kernel_opt_enabled. Previous stable rwdx-v3.3.

infra_sam: Collected logs from canary nodes. sample:

```
[2026-03-12T09:15:10Z] id=7f9a model=rwdx-v3.4 tokens=512 latency=150ms
[2026-03-12T09:16:41Z] id=8a2b model=rwdx-v3.4 tokens=2048 latency=910ms error=kv_eviction
[2026-03-12T09:16:43Z] id=9c3d model=rwdx-v3.4 tokens=4096 latency=1800ms error=oom_soft
```

ml_sre_mateo: Hypothesis A: new kernel_opt path interacts poorly with 8-bit KV cache eviction policy for long context sizes -> stalls and soft OOMs. Hypothesis B: scheduler change causing uneven GPU stream syncs for large batches.

prod_eng_lee: Can we do a quick canary-vs-stable diff on traces? Need hotspot breakdown.

ml_sre_mateo: Running trace diff... summary:
- p99 canary=1.8s stable=0.42s for token_count>1500
- 5xx canary=1.1% stable=0.02%
- CPU scheduling shows increased cuda_stream_sync calls in canary at attention_kernel_v3

infra_sam: small snippet from profiler (canary):
```
serve->attention_v3->kv_manager->serialize_batch->cuda_sync
GPU_util spike -> 97% at problematic spans
```

oncall_rita: We need an immediate mitigation. Options: 1) pause rollout and pin canary traffic to v3.3, 2) rollback canary hosts, 3) toggle kernel_opt flag off. Thoughts?

prod_eng_lee: Quickest: pin canary tag to v3.3 and stop new canary allocations. Also prepare a feature-flag to disable kernel_opt for follow-up testing.

deploy-bot: Command accepted: pause rollout. Repointing traffic tag=canary -> model=rwdx-v3.3. Expected propagation ~40s.

infra_sam: Traffic shifted. Monitoring: p95 back to baseline within ~70s. Support tickets updated.

support_maya: Notified customers they were routed back to stable model, shared incident acknowledgement and that we're investigating root cause.

ml_sre_mateo: Gathering artifacts to /artifacts/incidents/2120012345/: kernel traces, kv eviction logs, perf counters, canary host logs, diff reports. Will push reproducer test.

prod_eng_lee: Diff of selector logic (excerpt):
```diff
- if (context_len > 1024) use attention_v2;
- else use attention_v1;
+ if (context_len > 1024 && !quant_8bit) use attention_v2;
+ else use attention_v3; // v3 selected for 8bit long contexts
```

ml_sre_mateo: That explains why long 8bit contexts are hitting attention_v3. Repro steps: run batch of mixed short+long queries on quant=8bit and observe kv evictions + sync waits. I'll publish a reproducer by EOD.

oncall_rita: Handoff: passing pager to @ml_sre_mateo for RCA. I'll be available for escalation.

prod_eng_lee: Immediate action list:
- ml_sre_mateo: build reproducer, confirm kernel contention, propose selector gate (ETA 6h)
- infra_sam: verify routing/pinning invariants for Dedicated customers and autoscaler behavior (ETA 2h)
- support_maya: finalize customer comms + short post to status page (ETA 45m)

ml_sre_mateo: Decision log so far: paused rollout + traffic pinned to v3.3. Next steps: either gate v3.4 kernel path for quant_8bit+long_context or implement tighter kv eviction heuristics. Will propose in PR after repro.

prod_eng_lee: Add follow-up: update canary rollout checklist to include long-context load tests for quantized builds.

infra_sam: Note: found one routing edge-case where Dedicated fallback attempted to schedule onto a mixed pool for 30s during propagation; adding to action items.

support_maya: Customers acknowledged mitigation and asked for ETA. I'll include the ETA from the team once we have reproducer.

ml_sre_mateo: Closing the active pager for mitigation. Moving to RCA tracking in this thread. Will post timeline + artifacts and hypothesis updates. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: pause confirmed at 2026-03-12T09:17:25Z - canary traffic pinned to rwdx-v3.3

prod_eng_lee: Thanks all — we'll assemble a postmortem doc and link here when ready.
